name: CreateFlowLog

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the flow log. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 流日志所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the flow log.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
流日志名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: flow_log_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the flow log.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
流日志描述。

描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource whose traffic you want to catch. Valid values:

- **NetworkInterface**: network interface controllers (NICs).
  
- **VSwitch**: all network interface controllers (NICs) in a vSwitch.
  
- **VPC**: all network interface controllers (NICs) in a virtual private cloud (VPC)
parameters.help_zh:
要捕获流量的资源类型。取值：

- **NetworkInterface**：弹性网卡。
  
- **VSwitch**：交换机内的所有弹性网卡。
  
- **VPC**：专有网络内的所有弹性网卡
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource whose traffic you want to capture
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The traffic type to collect. Valid values:

- **All**: all traffic.
  
- **Allow**: traffic allowed by access control.
  
- **Drop**: traffic denied by access control
parameters.help_zh:
采集的流量类型。取值：

- **All**：全部流量。
  
- **Allow**：访问控制允许的流量。
  
- **Drop**：访问控制拒绝的流量
parameters.name: traffic_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the project that manages the captured traffic.
- The project name can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).
- The name must start and end with a lowercase letter or digit.
- The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
管理捕获到的流量的Project名称。
- Projec名称仅支持小写字母、数字和短划线（-）。
- 名称的开头与结尾必须为小写字母或数字。
- 名称长度为3~63个字符
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Logstore that stores the captured traffic.
- The Logstore name can contain only lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).
- The name must start and end with a lowercase letter or digit.
- The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
存储捕获到的流量的LogStore名称。
- LogStore名称仅支持小写字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。
- 名称的开头与结尾必须为小写字母或数字。
- 名称长度为3~63个字符
parameters.name: log_store_name

parameters.help_en: The sampling interval of the flow log. Unit: minutes. Valid values: **1**, **5**, and **10** (default)
parameters.help_zh: 流日志的采样间隔。单位：分钟。取值：**1**、**5**、**10**（默认值）
parameters.name: aggregation_interval

parameters.help_en:
The traffic path to capture. Valid values:

- **all**: captures all traffic.
- **internetGateway**: captures Internet traffic
parameters.help_zh:
采集的流量路径。取值：

- **all**：表示全量采集。
- **internetGateway**：表示公网流量采集
parameters.name: traffic_path

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

element_fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，请勿输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如果传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The IP version of the traffic captured by the flow log
parameters.help_zh: 流日志采集流量的IP地址类型
parameters.name: ip_version
